definition: Individual modified bracts that collectively form the involucre subtending a composite flower head (capitulum).

structural_components.series_graduation: Equal, subequal, or graduated (outer series shorter than inner).
structural_components.margins_and_texture: Foliaceous (herbaceous), scarious (dry/papery), spinose, or squarrose (recurved tips).

field_photo_protocol.involucre_profile: Direct lateral profile capturing peduncle attachment up to the floret bases.
field_photo_protocol.outer_series: 45-degree macro showing margin texture, cilia, and apical tip orientation.
